criteria.requirement: Extend Bottle.merge(routes, prefix=None). None must preserve legacy route identity/owner. An explicit absolute prefix clones routes with target ownership, copied route-specific plugins/skip/config and original callback, normalizes trailing slashes and supports dynamic built-in filters/reverse URLs without changing source rules. Target app plugin policy applies to clones, source app plugins are not implicitly copied. Reject bad prefixes and duplicate route names before adding any clones; preserve original source registration and callback behavior.
